source_snapshot.procedure: Power on with all fans, remove one fan, compare its status and survivor speeds through IPMI/BMC, verify other modules, reinsert and recheck, then repeat for every fan.
source_snapshot.criteria: Removal/reinsertion succeeds; IPMI/UI state is correct; all-fan speed is normal; survivor modules continue; removed-fan LED is off; remaining fans speed up; five cycles per fan.
source_snapshot.script: Private ipmi_sdr-sensor_list reference; contents unavailable and not assumed. Twenty minutes attended and ten machine minutes.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires a quantitative compensating-speed oracle and thermal abort curve; merely seeing RPM rise does not prove adequate N-minus-one cooling.

original_test_intent: Verify five powered hot-remove/reinsert cycles for every serviceable fan, including exact slot status, removed LED behavior, adequate survivor speed response, continued module health and restored cooling.
original_method: Map fan slots to sensors/LEDs/zones, establish all-fan RPM and thermal baselines, prove N-minus-one limits, then have a qualified operator remove one fan while automation captures status, RPM response, temperatures, SEL and module health before reinsertion and stable recovery.
manual_activity: Qualified operator removes/reinserts the exact approved fan and observes its physical LED while avoiding moving blades and airflow obstructions.
required_inputs: Temperature limits, dwell and hard abort
safety_requirements: Require approval for powered fan removal
Never guess fan or sensor identity
Confirm N-minus-one capability and ambient/load envelope
Keep hands/tools clear of moving impellers
Stop on hard limit, throttling, reset, extra fan stall or module fault
Require stable RPM/thermal recovery before next cycle
agent_execution_scope: Capture slot/sensor/zone mapping and baseline RPM/temperatures
Verify N-minus-one limits and module health
Guide but never perform physical action
Measure survivor RPM response and thermal trajectory

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Storage enumeration, dmesg and RAID state do not measure fan status, RPM compensation, LED state, temperature or module continuity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each mapped fan and each of five cycles, capture all-fan baseline, have the operator remove one module, measure absent status, survivor RPM and thermal response against approved limits, confirm LED/module continuity, reinsert it and require stable recovery before continuing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All fans, remove/reinsert order, IPMI/UI checks, compensating speed, LED, other-module continuity, five repetitions and 20/10-minute timing are preserved; RPM/temperature limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-zone timeline of target presence, survivor PWM/RPM, critical temperatures, throttling, SEL and recovery dwell keyed to fan slot and cycle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds quantitative cooling adequacy and abort controls to qualitative speed/status checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong sensor mapping, insufficient compensation, thermal overshoot, extra fan faults and incomplete control-loop recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A fan can speed up yet still provide insufficient airflow; sensor lag and recirculation require independent thermal limits and dwell.

project_override_considerations: The source's private SDR script may provide telemetry only after pinned review; it cannot establish physical fan/LED identity or N-minus-one adequacy by itself.
expected_evidence: No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target fan hot-service and compensation. Missing mapping and numerical limits are finite execution inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fan mapping, serviceability and thermal limits can be supplied. Execution becomes blocked only if safe N-minus-one operation or recovery cannot be proven.

review_improvement: Replaces unrelated storage checks with fan-control and thermal evidence and prevents repeated cycles when cooling compensation is inadequate.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fan hot-removal changes a coupled control loop: the correct evidence is not only target absence but survivor RPM/PWM response and bounded zone temperatures. Physical handling and LED observation remain manual, while BMC/IPMI telemetry and module continuity are automatable. The necessary limits are requestable, so REQUIRES is correct.
